WildClient

The project I’ve
grown up building.

A Minecraft client I founded in 2020, released in 2021 and grew to over 100,000 users. It’s where my work in Java, interface design and real-time graphics comes together.

Visit WildClient
The road from 2020
  1. 2020After game development, I started learning to build clients and made the first versions of Wild.
  2. 2021The September release brought the first users.
  3. 2022I rewrote Wild from scratch, moving from Forge to MCP. The project found its first larger audience.
  4. 2023Wild became a real source of income. I bought a computer and began preparing to move to Czechia.
  5. 2024After a serious conflict with my co-owner, I left the project for two years.
  6. 2026I returned to Wild with a renewed focus on quality.

The longer story

From 2018 to 2021, I worked on games. In 2020, I began learning client development and founded Wild. From 2021 to 2023, I also spent two years teaching at an IT school.

After leaving Wild in 2024, I started Ethereal.im, which remained unfinished. In 2025, I worked at Melonity for several months.

A personal turning point

In 2026, I quit my addictions, paid off my loans and rebuilt my life and principles. I returned to Wild with a renewed focus on quality.
